name: Slowing Down
source:
It's 2025. Right? Well, it's 2025 somewhere. I'm writing this letter while I circle the drain, waiting for my existence to become unobservable. You're in 2025, or 3025, or whatever, I don't know. Time doesn't exist for me anymore, so whenever or wherever you read this letter, I hope it reminds you of the best times of our lives.

[From [url=https://cross-couloir.itch.io/slowing-down]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
现在是2025年。对吧？好吧，现在是2025年。我一边写这封信，一边绕着下水道转，等待着我的存在变得无法被察觉。你现在是2025年，还是3025年，或者其他什么时间，我不知道。时间对我来说已经不存在了，所以无论何时何地，当你读到这封信时，我希望它能让你想起我们生命中最美好的时光。

[来自[url=https://cross-couloir.itch.io/slowing-down]itch.io[/url]]
